terbaru.judul: Beyond persuasion: Mobile electoral interfaces in polarized societies
terbaru.pelajaran: We propose a minimal dynamical model in which electoral competition is governed not by direct persuasion between opposing blocs, but by the dynamics and allocation of a mobile electoral interface.

terbaru.judul: Ising-machine-like Driving Condition Restrictions in SSBM and Additional Pseudo-annealing- Driving Method for SSBM that Achieves Best Cut Value Search -
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we discuss the conditions under which the SSBM can exhibit behavior analogous to that of a continuous-variable-type Ising machine, and report that by adding an effect similar to physical annealing to these conditions, the SSBM can be made to search for the best known cuts in K_{2000}.

terbaru.judul: Dynamics of fluctuating populations in multi-state switching environments
